findings.description: The red apple she has held in both hands since 00:00 gets smaller and fades between ~7.5s and ~7.9s. By 8.0s it is gone, and her hands just hold the bare umbrella shaft. Her hands never move to a pocket, bag or another person, so nothing explains the disappearance.

From about 4.0s, crates in the foreground stall hold uniform spheres in saturated teal/cyan, and later in purple trays. These don't look like real fruit or vegetables and read as generated filler produce.

The setting starts as an open-air street market with red awnings and a dense crowd walking down the lane. As the camera orbits, it gradually turns into a covered market hall with white crates, purple trays and only a few shoppers. The geometry doesn't match the original street layout, so the location seems to morph rather than being revealed by the camera move.

Earlier her ponytail is mostly dark brown with a little lighter tone. From about 8.5s to 9.75s it shows a strongly golden/blonde ombre lower half. The change is larger than lighting alone would explain.
